review_scope: Manual source-art observations for the owner preview; NOT a formal ENEMY_REVIEW PASS or Godot capture review.
limitations: Single flattened cutouts, not separated rig layers. In-engine scale, grounding, crop, overlap with hero/UI and lighting have not been tested. Exact generation references and policy fingerprint are recorded separately for every candidate. Pixel PASS is not creative approval.

observations.wolf: Broad grey fur tufts, drawn facial planes and red accents replace granular fur. Four paws and full tail are visible; pilot alpha preview retained.
observations.wild_dog: Brown/charcoal grouped fur and painted muzzle retain the lean feral dog identity, distinct from the larger wolf; four complete legs and small tail.
observations.slime: Painted teal liquid lobes, violet eyes/core and clean mouth replace photographic caustics. Naturally limbless; detached droplets are an effect and need separate treatment if animated.
observations.boar: Broad charcoal/russet bristles and ivory tusks keep the heavy boar silhouette. Four hoofed legs and red corruption are retained without photographic hide.
observations.cursed_scarecrow: Grouped ochre straw, coat folds and drawn black face with red eyes. Complete curved scythe, hands and straw feet; grounded dry-plains identity.
observations.plains_spirit: Broad slate/cyan robe ribbons and drawn skeletal hands replace filament-like cloth. Cyan lantern and dry-grass motifs preserved. Ribbon alpha gaps locally cleaned; no invented feet on the naturally dissolving ghost.
observations.nature_guardian: Broad wooden armor planes, olive moss and amber core preserve the treant. V2 includes the complete branch crown, shield and root feet, unlike clipped v1.
observations.venom_spider: Brown/olive chitin, chartreuse venom and broad plate shading fit the forest palette. V3 keeps the body and extremities inside the frame, but far-side leg overlaps still prevent confident counting/tracing of eight walking legs.
observations.forest_cultist: Deer-skull mask, drawn ivory antlers and grouped olive robes remain recognizable. Staff and boots are complete; bone/rope surfaces are illustrated rather than pore-textured.
observations.rotting_knight: Broader iron planes and fewer painted corrosion patches. Green visor, sword, shield and two boots remain distinct, without exposing an unrelated human face.
observations.corrupted_bear: Grouped charcoal fur and localized violet fissures retain hefty bear anatomy. Interior violet corruption is intentionally preserved by alpha processing, not treated as background.
observations.black_hart: Clear dark antler branches, grouped plum fur and restrained magenta veins. Four slim hooved legs; reviewed gaps between antlers/fur cleaned without erasing the corruption veins.
observations.gallows_wraith: Drawn grey face/hands, broad grey ribbons and ochre noose distinguish it from the lantern ghost. Both bare feet visible; pink matte flecks locally cleaned from grey cloth/hair.
observations.blackwood_executioner: Broad illustrated muscular arm and iron/bark armor retain asymmetry. V2 restores full branch tips and frame; axe and both heavy boots remain visible.
observations.bog_crawler: Large olive/ochre hide plates and blunt reptile head replace granular mud. Low four-legged body and long tapering tail keep its marsh identity.
observations.drowned_dead: Drawn slate skin and broad teal coat folds retain the waterlogged undead. Two hands and boots remain readable; algae simplified into larger strips.
observations.swamp_witch: Illustrated mature face and grouped brown hair match class rendering while retaining olive ragged dress, branch staff and boots; not recolored as the player mage.
observations.bone_crocodile: Ivory bone plates over olive hide replace porous bone textures. V2 reveals four separate clawed feet; long snout, teeth and curling tail stay inside frame.
observations.mist_walker: Ochre reed bundles, long bird-skull beak and drawn claws keep the strange marsh identity. Two long digitigrade legs; no separate birds or background fog.
observations.drowned_mother: Drawn face, grouped dark hair and grey-olive robe folds align with class illustration while keeping the bone/reed crown. V2 contains the full staff, bare feet and trailing robe. Local matte cleanup preserves the muted costume palette.
observations.boneburner: Larger illustrated charred-bone forms and cloth strips preserve the thin ember-ribbed undead. Two arms and clawed feet; rust/ivory/charcoal regional identity retained.
observations.red_salamander: Broader red scale groups and orange crest planes replace constant tiny molten highlights. Four connected legs and a complete long curling tail, without new wings.
observations.hearth_devourer: Broader scorched plates and clear orange furnace ribs retain the towering horned silhouette. Two clawed hands and feet; chains and cloth are subordinate to body shape.
observations.azhar: Drawn mature face and broad ochre/rust robe folds retain pale hair, crown and curved polearm. Full weapon and boots visible; no unrelated violet/blue hero palette.
observations.frozen_castaway: Broad painted icy facets and navy coat folds replace microcrystalline crust. Full cutlass, icy hand and two boots; mature undead sailor identity preserved.
observations.ice_crab: Large blue/white ice facets, drawn shell plates and clear claws replace granular ice. Reuses the alpha-checked pilot; feet/grounding still need Godot capture review.

needs_revision.venom_spider: Dopracować czytelność ośmiu nóg: dalsze odnóża nadal nakładają się. Nie zatwierdzać do riggingu ani produkcji na podstawie samego podglądu stylu.
